messages.subject: problem with circularnormal distribution
parts:
Dear all,

The model below fails to converge. Any suggestions? I'm using INLA 24.02.07

Best regards,

Thierry

test <- data.frame(
  yaw = c(
    2.3, 0.391, -1.223, -0.432, -0.802, -2.781, -1.113, -0.357,
    -0.508, -0.367, -0.639, 3.066, -1.146, -0.336, -0.441, -0.59,
    -0.271, -0.721, -2.842, -1.311, -0.432, -0.526, -0.766, -0.703,
    -3.047, -0.323, -0.41, -0.575, -0.245, -0.113, -0.828, -0.039,
    0.436, 0.011, -0.152, -0.198, -0.028, 0.377)
)
inla(
  yaw ~ 1, family = "circularnormal", data = test, safe = FALSE, verbose = TRUE
)
exit diagonal hessian due to early_stop
enable early_stop ff < f0: 65.987982 < 66.336344 (diff -0.348362)

maxld= -65.493 fn=226367 theta= 0.639 [0.04, 0.000]
maxld= -65.301 fn=226369 theta= 0.565 [0.04, 0.000]
enable early_stop ff < f0: 65.300827 < 65.493003 (diff -0.192176)

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] problem with circularnormal distribution
parts:
I got the model running by setting inla.mode = "classic". The same model using brms gave somewhat different parameters.

library(INLA)

m_inla <- inla(
  yaw ~ 1, family = "circularnormal", data = test, inla.mode = "classic"
)

library(brms)
m_brm <- brm(
  yaw ~ 1, family = von_mises(), data = test, chains = 4, warmup = 1000,
  iter = 3000, cores = 4, thin = 2
)
summary(m_inla)
summary(m_brm)
